strategyPoints: Tire degradation will be a major factor on this abrasive surface. Managing the rubber through the Curva do Café will be key.
With a lap length of just over 3 kilometers, fuel consumption will be tight, especially in the early stages of the race.
The pit window is relatively short here; a quick stop is essential to avoid losing track position.
Teams will be closely monitoring tire temperatures, especially on the right-front, which takes a beating through the fast corners.
Undercut could be powerful here, with the short lap and tight corners making it difficult to overtake on track.
A safety car could completely change the complexion of the race, so teams need to be ready to react quickly.
The historic configuration of Londrina favors cars with good mechanical grip and strong cornering ability.
With limited run-off areas, a mistake can be costly, so drivers need to be precise and avoid pushing too hard too early.
